csv_project_name: Consultant for CC&R mandated Architectural Control Projects
csv_agency: El Dorado Hills Community Services District
csv_scope_of_work: El Dorado Hills Community Services District (EDHCSD) is seeking information from qualified local vendors to facilitate inspections required by District procedures for CC&R mandated Architectural Control projects. This Request for Information (RFI) is intended to assess market interest and vendor capabilities prior to issuing a formal Request for Proposal (RFP) starting fiscal year 2028. For this request, the services will include: Inspection of grading, construction, site management, and structures Measurement of setbacks and structure location Construction plan interpretation and comparison Plot plan interpretation and comparison Tracking inspection timelines Coordinating with homeowners to schedule inspections
